review_scope: Independent playback review of PR #3; actual policy modules and explicit I/O doubles; no device session or deployment

findings.title_zh: 原生 monitor 将读取未知及同实例终态误判为换片，提前跳过终态与停止收尾

related_locations.role: Exhausted OSError reads collapse to False
No observed instance, including legitimate same-instance terminal, collapses to False
Terminal reconciliation, continuation boundary and stop bookkeeping skipped by early return
New immutable terminal reader is correct but bypassed in these two monitor paths
Real owner terminal operation stores receipt and clears observed

trigger_paths.preconditions: The exact request has verified AVStart; desired, observed and native instance remain unchanged
trigger_paths.trigger: All three attempts in one bounded owned_state read raise OSError; the next read succeeds for the same instance
trigger_paths.actual: monitor marks superseded, returns, sets local cancellation and never reaches progress/terminal/continuation/stop boundaries even though playback and fresh authority remain current

trigger_paths.preconditions: isPlayingVideo returned true and the first ownership read saw the current instance
trigger_paths.trigger: Actual PlaybackOwner.observe_terminal(native-A, NATURAL_EOF) runs before the second snapshot; observed is legitimately removed while desired remains current
trigger_paths.actual: matching predicate returns False; monitor marks superseded and returns with local UNKNOWN despite matching authoritative NATURAL_EOF

findings.impact_zh: 本次原生监控可能提前终止，跳过自然 EOF 续播边界、停止历史收尾和终态 UI；回放未声称验证实际数据库写入或设备故障频率
limits: Actual production owner and request modules, with unmodified AST extraction of production monitor methods
Kodi state, IPC transport, clock and unrelated optional monitor work are explicit doubles
Continuation and stop bookkeeping bodies are call-boundary spies; not an end-to-end successor submission or database test
No television or live service connection; not device certification
EOF failure is a legal scheduling race, not a claim that every EOF fails
fix_requirements: Distinguish current active instance, matching terminal, explicit replacement/cancel and unavailable observation
Retire immediately on explicit request/boot/epoch/account change or cancellation
Do not grant command authority from cached state during unavailable reads
Use bounded paced observation for unavailable reads; matching terminal must reach immutable terminal reconciliation
Keep existing 3-second terminal reconciliation and standard 20-second absolute EOF deadline
Preserve at-most-once successor authorization and exact native identity
Do not infer native EOF from absent video, near-end position or I/O failure

previous_findings.reason: Optional subtitle work now consumes at most two seconds and leaves one second before the existing absolute media deadline; delayed candidates remain optional
Valid progress freshness has a separate progress_observed timestamp; invalid 0/0 does not refresh EOF evidence

test_runs.name: Current standard and CE2012/CE2014 focused regression tests
Independent native monitor counterexamples and positive controls on head
Same native monitor replay on base-equivalent snapshot

counting_note: Do not add base replays or peer replays as separate unique cases. Current repository tests may overlap the root agent's full suite. One finding has two trigger paths.
